body.name: EffectSet
body.sig: \(\mathcal T_E(\Sigma)=\{g_D(\Sigma):D\in\mathcal R(E)\}\) for \(E\in\mathfrak S_p\) and \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\)
body.def: Finite plug-in effect set on the positive-definite cone; at \(E=C\) and \(\Sigma\in\mathcal M(C)\) it is the component's causal-effect target.
